mcq_fix.s: Which port has now overtaken Deendayal (Kandla) to become India's largest cargo-handling major port?
mcq_fix.why: stem 'according to the 2026 ranking cited' is oddly worded

pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: mean sea level / Survey of India datum
wrong topic: coal reserves; options 1 and 2 garbled (both read 'is the correct')
garbled: depends on a map not reproduced
wrong options: percentages given for a count of airlines
wrong topic: modern Indian history chronology; options truncated

patterns: APPSC asks single-fact port items: state with most major ports (Tamil Nadu), largest cargo port (key answer has shifted Kandla -> Paradip), AP's major port Visakhapatnam.
Reasoning statements on why the east coast has fewer ports (shallow shelf, cyclones) - APPSC 2023 statement type.
Civil aviation firsts: 1911 Allahabad-Naini airmail, 1953 Air Corporations Act nationalisation.
Transport 'firsts' (six-lane Mumbai-Pune expressway, Cochin solar airport) recur across PSCs.
App adds many 2025-26 data and LPPI-ranking statement items that go deeper than the PYQs; inland waterways (NW-1 etc.) are barely covered by app MCQs despite the topic title.
